CVE-2026-47701 (GHSA-cxh2-4639-vmc5) is scoped to the TargetAllocator in cmd/otel-allocator, where a selected ServiceMonitor endpoint's bearerTokenFile is preserved into the generated Prometheus scrape configuration; see https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-operator/security/advisories/GHSA-cxh2-4639-vmc5. Scout matches github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-operator at the module level. cmd/otel-allocator is a standalone main command that cannot be imported by other modules, and the shipped localmodelnode-agent binary links only the operator's apis/v1beta1 API types plus the internal/components, internal/naming, and pkg/featuregate helpers. No TargetAllocator, Prometheus CR watcher, or scrape-config symbols are present in the binary, so the vulnerable code is not shipped in this image.

The vulnerability is in the TargetAllocator (cmd/otel-allocator, internal/watcher/promOperator.go), which converts ServiceMonitor endpoints into Prometheus scrape config and leaks bearerTokenFile contents. The localmodel-controller binary imports opentelemetry-operator only for CRD type registration (apis/v1beta1 AddToScheme); it does not import or run the cmd/otel-allocator package, so the vulnerable conversion code is not compiled into the shipped binary and is not reachable in this image.
